newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wella higher on dlr, technical signals.
newsitem.headline: Wella higher on dlr, technical signals.

text.p: Ordinary and preference shares in haircare-product maker Wella AG rose strongly in bourse trade on Thursday, lifted by a combination of technical factors and the strength of the dollar.
At 1120 GMT Wella preference shares were up 33 marks, or 3.80 percent, at 902 marks, while ordinary shares in the group were up 31 marks at 901 marks.
The overall MDAX index of German medium sized companies was up 0.68 percent at 3,346.75 points.
"Wella has been underperforming lately and needed a recovery," said one dealer.
Dealers also said the share had penetrated a point of technical resistance. "The technical outlook for the group is wonderful," said one trader.
